note: Pins for external binaries used by the feasibility spike. sha256 stays null until the exact release artifact is downloaded and verified; a null sha256 fails the prerequisite check on purpose so a build never trusts an unverified jar.

gtfs_validator.note: Pin the exact MobilityData gtfs-validator-cli release filename/version once selected; see docs/DATA-SOURCES.md and docs/SOL-HANDOFF.md.

osm_extract.note: Small overlapping OSM PBF extract for the synthetic smoke network's street data. Reuse an appropriately licensed existing OTP test fixture rather than building a road graph.
